title: ee.focus.suggest.v1
description: Read-only recommendation surface for `ee focus suggest` (bd-sg5si). Returns the topics, CASS spans, and pre-formatted follow-up queries an agent should pivot attention toward, ranked by graph centrality over recent CASS evidence. Phase 1 pins the schema and emits an empty `recommendations` array plus an `info`-severity `focus_suggest_unimplemented` degraded entry; Phase 2 (`implements-surface:focus_suggest`) lands the PageRank/HITS scoring and CASS-span ranking that populate the array.

recommendations.description: Ranked focus recommendations. Empty in Phase 1; populated by the centrality + recent-CASS scoring pipeline in Phase 2.

topic.description: Short topic label summarizing what the agent should focus on next.

spanIds.description: CASS span IDs that support this recommendation. At least one entry when `fromCass` is true.

centralityScore.description: Graph centrality contribution to the rank. Higher is more central; absolute scale is implementation-dependent.

rationale.description: Why this topic surfaced. Cites the centrality signal and the recent-CASS evidence.

suggestedQuery.description: Concrete ee command (typically `ee context` or `ee search`) the agent can run to act on the recommendation.

fromCass.description: True when the recommendations were derived from CASS evidence; false when only the durable memory graph contributed.

limit.description: Maximum number of recommendations the response may return. Mirrors `--limit` (default 5).

recentHours.description: Look-back window in hours for the recent-CASS evidence. Mirrors `--recent-hours` (default 24).

recommendations.rationale: PageRank dominator over the last 24h of CASS evidence; six bead closures cite this topic.
